$ kubectl delete pod typo
--- exit 0
--- stdout
pod "typo" deleted
--- stderr

$ kubectl delete pod typo
--- exit 1 (NOT_FOUND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (NotFound): pods "typo" not found

$ kubectl delete pod typo --ignore-not-found
--- exit 0
--- stdout
--- stderr

$ kubectl delete pods -l app=nginx
--- exit 0
--- stdout
pod "nginx-4fzxcz7snh-tbjxs" deleted
--- stderr

$ kubectl get pods -l app=nginx
--- exit 0
--- stdout
NAME                     READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
nginx-4fzxcz7snh-ckn96   1/1     Running   0          0s
--- stderr

$ kubectl events --for replicaset/nginx-4fzxcz7snh
--- exit 0
--- stdout
LAST SEEN   TYPE     REASON             OBJECT                        MESSAGE
60m         Normal   SuccessfulCreate   replicaset/nginx-4fzxcz7snh   Created pod: nginx-4fzxcz7snh-tbjxs
0s          Normal   SuccessfulCreate   replicaset/nginx-4fzxcz7snh   Created pod: nginx-4fzxcz7snh-ckn96
--- stderr

$ kubectl delete pods
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: resource(s) were provided, but no name was specified

$ kubectl delete pods -l app=nope
--- exit 0
--- stdout
--- stderr
No resources found

$ kubectl delete pod picky --force --grace-period=0
--- exit 0
--- stdout
pod "picky" deleted
--- stderr
Warning: Immediate deletion does not wait for confirmation that the running resource has been terminated. The resource may continue to run on the cluster indefinitely.

$ kubectl delete ns default
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (Forbidden): namespaces "default" is forbidden: this namespace may not be deleted

$ kubectl delete node node-1
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (Forbidden): nodes "node-1" is forbidden: nodes are part of the simulated cluster and can't be created or deleted (labels and annotations can change)

$ kubectl delete svc kubernetes
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (Forbidden): services "kubernetes" is forbidden: this Service is managed by the API server (KubeDojo keeps it in place)

$ kubectl delete endpointslices --all
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (Forbidden): endpointslices.discovery.k8s.io "web-np-4fhqh" is forbidden: EndpointSlices are managed by the EndpointSlice controller; change the Service or its Pods instead
Error from server (Forbidden): endpointslices.discovery.k8s.io "web-sj9wz" is forbidden: EndpointSlices are managed by the EndpointSlice controller; change the Service or its Pods instead

$ kubectl delete events --all
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: events are maintained by the simulator and can't be changed with kubectl delete

$ kubectl delete cm,secret --all -o name
--- exit 0
--- stdout
configmap/app-config
secret/db-creds
--- stderr

$ kubectl delete deploy nginx --cascade=orphan
--- exit 0
--- stdout
deployment.apps "nginx" deleted
--- stderr

$ kubectl get deploy,rs,pods
--- exit 0
--- stdout
NAME                               DESIRED   CURRENT   READY   AGE

NAME                         READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
pod/nginx-4fzxcz7snh-ckn96   1/1     Running   0          30s
--- stderr

$ kubectl delete rs --all
--- exit 0
--- stdout
replicaset.apps "nginx-4fzxcz7snh" deleted
--- stderr

$ kubectl get pods
--- exit 0

--- stderr

$ kubectl delete ns shop
--- exit 0
--- stdout

--- stderr

$ kubectl get all -n shop
--- exit 0
--- stdout

ⓘ The namespace "shop" doesn't exist. List namespaces with: kubectl get namespaces

$ kubectl delete svc web web-np nope
